article.excerpt: 1. From London to Elista: The Inside Story of the Three Matches that Vladimir Kramnik Played for the World Chess Title , by Eugeny Bareev and Ilya Levitov. Via John Nye, the quality and drama of this book stunned me. Chess aside, the use of the dialogic form works remarkably well. 2. The Yacoubian Building , by Alaa Al Aswany.
